critical_code_review_comments: Edge case note: When SL * 1.05 > entry * 0.97 (very tight SL, e.g., sl > entry * 0.924), the BBE floor and ceiling conflict. Code applies floor first, then ceiling caps it — so result may be < SL*1.05. This is intentional (ceiling takes priority when SL is unrealistically tight), but worth documenting.

The 'Bias Point' string still exists as a comment in exportUtils.js line 34 ('Best Exit: replaces Bias Point') — this is informational only and the actual column key is correctly 'Best Exit ₹'. No action needed.
